newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open barely changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open barely changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open barely changed Wednesday in line with quiet overnight dealings and the smooth passing of the July LME options declaration in London.
COMEX September copper closed Tuesday at 110.05 cents a lb, and traded between 112.45 and 109.70 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks jumped 1,750 tonnes to 130,075 tonnes Wednesday.
Tuesday, COMEX warehouse copper stocks fell 1,524 short tons to 44,746 short tons.
The LME cash to three months backwardation contracted overnight but widened out again to $125/$130 a tonne.
